name: Lowe's Business Rewards Card from American Express

localized_names.en: Lowe's Business Rewards Card from American Express

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% foreign transaction fee (standard American Express rate).

rewards.currency_label: Lowe's Business Rewards points (worth ~1 cent each; redeemable for statement credits or Lowe's/Amex gift cards)

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases

categories.label: Lowe's, U.S. restaurants, U.S. office supply stores, and wireless telephone services from U.S. service providers

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards are earned as Lowe's Business Rewards points (each worth ~1 cent), redeemable for statement credits or Lowe's/American Express gift cards — not Membership Rewards. Intro offer: 5% cash back on eligible Lowe's purchases for the first six months (2% thereafter). Cardholders also receive an automatic 5% discount on eligible Lowe's purchases at checkout, which is separate from rewards.

benefits.title: 5% Off Eligible Lowe's Purchases
benefits.description: Automatic 5% discount on eligible in-store and online purchases at Lowe's when using the card.

benefits.title: Free Employee Cards
benefits.description: Issue up to 99 employee cards at no additional cost to track and manage business spending.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary car rental loss and damage coverage of up to $50,000 per rental agreement when you reserve and pay with the card and decline the rental company's collision waiver. Terms and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Up to one additional year of warranty coverage on eligible purchases with a manufacturer's warranty, up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for eligible purchases that are damaged or stolen within 90 days, up to $1,000 per incident and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 Global Assist Hotline for medical, legal, financial, and other emergency coordination when traveling more than 100 miles from home.

notes: No-annual-fee Lowe's co-brand business card issued by American Express (usable anywhere Amex is accepted). Earns 2% cash back at Lowe's, U.S. restaurants, U.S. office supply stores, and U.S. wireless telephone services, and 1% on all other eligible purchases. Intro offer: 5% back at Lowe's for the first six months. Cardholders also get an automatic 5% discount on eligible Lowe's purchases. Rewards are Lowe's Business Rewards points (~1 cent each), redeemable as statement credits or Lowe's/Amex gift cards — not Membership Rewards (corrected). Amex-branded protections (car rental, extended warranty, purchase protection, Global Assist) and up to 99 free employee cards. The Amex product URL redirects to the general business-cards gallery (card is applied for through Lowe's), so earn rates and benefits were verified via the American Express cardmember agreement and Business Insider. Prior image was wrong-product art (Business Platinum) and was cleared.
